text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, your tie is slightly crooked.
...Ah, right there. That looks fine.
choice_data_list: I'm glad you noticed, thank you.

text_block_list.text:
Today, I was attending a boat party full
of racing
industry figures, to which Duramente had
been invited.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
First, we should greet the host.
Let us go.

text_block_list.name: Party Host
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, I look forward to your future
successes even more!
Truly what one would expect from the
shining star of an athletic dynasty!
How about it, care to showcase that talent
for us?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —And what might that entail?

text_block_list.name: Party Host
text_block_list.text:
We've arranged a fencing match for
entertainment.
You see, another horsegirl happens to be
in attendance.
And just like you, she is the shining star
of her lineage!

text_block_list.name: Party Host
text_block_list.text:
In which case, what could be finer than a
clash between two rising stars?
—What say you, Lady Rose Kingdom?
choice_data_list: Rose Kingdom... So you're here as well.

Rose Kingdom... I didn't know you were
here too.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Very well.
If that is your wish.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
As a scion of an athletic bloodline,
refusal is not an option.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Behold the strength that my clan
has cultivated through the generations.

A throng of guests gathered around the
stage to watch
the duel. Yet, far removed from the
surrounding bustle,
a taut, quiet tension gripped the two
contenders.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
We both bear the weight of our lineages.
I will not hold back.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: I would expect nothing less.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(A magnificent stance. Supple, graceful...
And yet... entirely without opening.)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Just facing her makes it plain.
She is an extraordinary opponent—!

It happened in the blink of an eye.
Rose Kingdom's blade found its mark
above Duramente's hip, scoring a point.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Fencing originated in France.
The progenitor of the Rose dynasty was
French as well...
Thus, I cannot afford to suffer defeat.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I must demonstrate to all
that the Rose Kingdom stands firm and
true!

A fierce exchange of blows ensued. Even
knowing
they wielded blunt foils and wore armor
beneath their clothes,
the sight was breathtaking enough to make
my heart race.
choice_data_list: (Both of them... The speed is incredible!)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(Despite her graceful appearance, her
strikes are razor-sharp—!)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(Fencing is a sport deeply rooted in
chivalry.
It is not mere elegance—it carries real,
formidable weight.)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(She could never have reached this height
otherwise.
A legacy forged in continuous battle—is
that the Rose lineage?!)

Rose Kingdom unleashed a flurry of rapid
thrusts.
Forced entirely on the defensive,
Duramente couldn't counter.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(However...
My clan, too, stands atop endless trials.)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(Faster, stronger—we sought the pinnacle
without end.
That is why... I am the culmination of
this bloodline!)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
My defeat would stain every ounce of my
family's toil...!
I will not allow it...!)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I shall prove it... I am the true
culmination of this blood!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: RAAAAGH!

text_block_list.name: Host and Guests
text_block_list.text:
"Incredible! It feels like a real duel!"
"Keep it up, both of you!" "I can't even
see the blades!"

The guests erupted into wild cheers.
Crowding together in their excitement,
their movements
even caused the deck to tremble slightly.

As I shifted my gaze from the spectators
back to the stage,
a dark silhouette suddenly swept into
view—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—?! The vibrations must have knocked it
over...!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Trainer, get down!
(CLANG! —CRASH!)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...That was close.
Thank goodness...

The shattered vase lay a short distance
away.
Duramente had leaped from the stage in a
single bound
and deflected it mid-air with her foil.
choice_data_list:
Thank you. But because of that, the match
was interrupted...

Thanks, Dura. But your duel got
interrupted...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
The fencing match?
...Proving my bloodline means nothing
without you.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
It holds no value.
At least, that is what I believe.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
So that was the source of such speed.
No wonder I was outmatched.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Out of respect for that bond,
the victory is yours.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
It was an honor to cross blades with you,
Duramente.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Rose was formidable.
I lost myself in the heat of the moment
and became reckless.
choice_data_list: That fiery intensity was amazing, though.
You truly fought like the strongest!

text_block_list.text:
I told her that both of them were
magnificent in their own right—
Rose Kingdom with her princely grace, and
Duramente
with her fierce, wild spirit.
choice_data_list:
When you leaped to save me, you looked
just like a knight.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
A knight... Is that how I appeared to you?
Heh, I see.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Not bad at all.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Then it seems I managed to protect both:
my title as the strongest, and my Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Still, it remains true that Rose gave me a
difficult battle.
I must dedicate myself to further
training.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Now that our honor is preserved, I can
finally relax.
...And now that I've relaxed, I find I'm
rather hungry.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, it would be a waste to ignore
such fine food.
Let us enjoy it together.
